name: StateRules
description: Rules per state of the type's Workflow: the own fields an instance must hold to enter a state, and the ones that cannot change while it is in it. A field is held when it is neither absent nor null. A transition into a state while a field it requires is not held is vetoed, and a create whose initial state requires one is refused at the field. An update, a caller's or one a behavior's operation applies, that clears a field the instance's state requires, or changes one it freezes, is vetoed; a caller with the config's permission may change a frozen field. Requires Workflow.

permission.description: The permission a caller needs to change a field a state freezes; nobody may when absent. What a state requires holds for every caller.

by.description: Who may change a field the state freezes: own fields that hold a subject, createdBy among them, and seats of the table's Seats, each as seat:<name>. A caller who is the subject one of the fields holds, or who is seated in one of the seats, before the update, changes a frozen field as a caller with the config's permission does; a field with no value names no one, and what the state requires holds for every caller. Refused in a state that freezes nothing. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

frozen.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, that do not change while the instance is in the state, or all, every one of them.

required.description: The type's own top-level fields, by JSON key, an instance must hold to enter the state, and keeps while it is in it.

states.description: The rules, by a state of the type's Workflow.

status.description: The field of the type whose Workflow the states are of. Implied when the type has one Workflow; needed when it has several. A Workflow anchored on the type is named Workflow. A table's alone: an engine type refuses it.

vetoes.description: A Workflow transition into a state while a field the state requires is absent or null; details names the state and the fields.
An update, a caller's or one an operation applies, that changes a field the instance's state freezes, by a caller without the config's permission; details names the state and the fields.
An update, a caller's or one an operation applies, that clears a field the instance's state requires; details names the state and the fields.
